title: Vulkan: X-Lite
description: A hardcore Vulkan-optimized modpack. Engineered to strip away OpenGL bottlenecks, maximize multi-core CPU efficiency, and push raw FPS to the absolute limit.
body:
# ⚡ V U L K A N : X - L I T E

Welcome to **Vulkan: X-Lite**, an uncompromising, bare-metal performance modpack designed exclusively for PC players. 

Much like a custom, debloated operating system that disables useless background services to free up system resources, this modpack strips away the heavy overhead of Minecraft's default OpenGL engine. By replacing it entirely with the **Vulkan API** and integrating a classified blend of deep backend micro-optimizations, X-Lite forces the game to run at absolute peak efficiency. 

This pack is built to utilize your hardware properly—ensuring that high-thread-count CPUs and powerful GPUs are no longer bottlenecked by ancient rendering codes. 

---

## 🚀 The X-Lite Philosophy

We do not rely on mainstream visual bloat. The internal architecture of this pack is a carefully guarded combination of engine tweaks designed to lower frame times, reduce memory footprint, and uncap your raw frames per second. 

### 🔧 Under the Hood: What X-Lite Does

*   **Vulkan Render Engine:** Bypasses OpenGL completely, offering substantially better multi-threading and direct communication with your GPU.
*   **Aggressive Memory Management:** Prevents memory leaks and strips away useless background initialization tasks, meaning the game loads instantly and stays smooth for hours.
*   **Concurrent Multi-Threading:** Forces world generation, entity physics, and chunk loading to utilize multiple CPU cores simultaneously. No more single-core bottlenecks.
*   **Logic & Network Micro-Optimization:** Redstone calculations, entity collisions, and network packets are rewritten at the code level to eliminate lag spikes and maintain a flawless TPS (Ticks Per Second).
*   **Smart UI Pacing:** Throttles the rendering of UI elements (like menus and inventories) so your GPU can dedicate 100% of its power to rendering the actual world.
*   **Zero Bloatware:** No heavy shader packs. No unnecessary UI clutter. Just pure, unadulterated performance.

---

## 💻 Recommended Setup

Because the internal architecture operates with extreme efficiency, you do not need to assign excessive resources. 

*   **RAM Allocation:** Only **4GB** of allocated RAM is needed to run this pack flawlessly. The internal memory managers will handle the rest.
*   **Requirements:** A dedicated graphics card that supports the Vulkan API (NVIDIA, AMD, or modern Intel GPUs).
*   **⚠️ STRICT WARNING:** Do not attempt to add OpenGL-dependent mods like Sodium, Iris, or OptiFine to this pack. They are strictly incompatible with the Vulkan engine and will cause immediate crashes.

Boot up, log in, and experience the raw speed of X-Lite.
